connectors.epic.name: Epic Games
connectors.epic.errors.invalidId: This Epic Games game has an invalid identifier and cannot be opened.
connectors.epic.errors.launcherMissing: The Epic Games launcher is needed to install this game. Download it from epicgames.com.
connectors.epic.login.title: Sign in to Epic Games
connectors.epic.login.body: Sign in to Epic Games in the new tab. When it finishes you will see some text between curly braces: copy all of it and press “Paste”. Epic warns you not to share that code: Ludiary uses it only on this computer to talk to Epic.
connectors.epic.error.code: The code has expired or was already used. Sign in again and copy the new text.
connectors.epic.error.corrective: Epic asks you to confirm something on its website. Go to epicgames.com, accept it and connect again.
connectors.epic.error.expired: Epic Games has signed you out. Reconnect the account.
connectors.epic.disconnect.hint: Ludiary deletes its Epic Games session from this computer. To sign out everywhere, change your password at epicgames.com.
